sourceReviewSummary: Dates were checked against the official Fulton County Schools calendar page and the approved 2027–28 PDF. We verified break dates, student-off days, semester dates, instructional-day totals, and the election-day remote learning note.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF was approved on December 18, 2025, and lists 180 instructional days: 88 in the first semester and 92 in the second.
Return dates are calculated from the published break ranges, intervening weekends and holidays, and the January 3 student-off day after December Break.
The PDF notes that statewide election days will be remote for students unless otherwise indicated.
Check the official Fulton calendar page for revisions before making travel, child care, or school-specific plans.

calendarNotes: Fulton County Schools lists 180 instructional days for 2027–28: 88 in the first semester and 92 in the second. Students start August 2, 2027 and finish May 25, 2028. The approved PDF lists October 11 and January 3 as student-off days and notes that statewide election days will be remote for students unless otherwise indicated.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after December Break?
calendarFaqs.a: December Break runs December 20–31, 2027. Students are also off Monday, January 3, 2028, and return for the second semester on Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: What does the election-day remote learning note mean?
calendarFaqs.a: The approved PDF says statewide election days will be remote for students unless otherwise indicated. Families should check Fulton updates before election days for school-specific instructions.

calendarFaqs.q: Are October 11 and January 3 student days off?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Fulton County Schools lists October 11, 2027 and January 3, 2028 as student-off days on the approved 2027–28 calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for calendar revisions?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Fulton County Schools calendar page and the district PDF for final confirmation before making travel, child care, or school-specific plans.

comparisonTitle: How Fulton’s Calendar Compares with Nearby Districts
comparisonSummary: Fulton shares its August 2 start date with Atlanta Public Schools and Cobb County. All four districts schedule Spring Break for April 3–7, while their Fall Break dates differ.

comparisonInsights.label: Start date comparison
items: Fulton, Atlanta Public Schools, and Cobb County all begin classes on August 2. Gwinnett begins on August 4.

comparisonInsights.label: Final student day comparison
items: Fulton’s final student day is May 25. Atlanta Public Schools ends May 26, Cobb ends May 17, and Gwinnett ends May 24.

customSections.label: What Changed from 2026–27
customSections.content: The 2027–28 calendar returns Fulton to 180 instructional days and uses a full-week Fall Break rather than the shorter 2026–27 Fall Break followed by staff workdays.

rows: The approved 2027–28 calendar lists 88 first-semester days and 92 second-semester days.
First student day moves from August 3 to August 2
Students start one day earlier than in 2026–27.
Final student day moves from May 27 to May 25
The school year ends earlier in May than the 2026–27 calendar.
Unlike 2026–27, the break itself covers the full Monday-through-Friday week.
